nanning-2017.notes: Source 1 disagrees with the earlier reader: the crawl's seed page is a real ranklist of this contest and 14 other pages are 2017 pages of the Guangxi University contest site; roles changed to web only (the ranklist is already source 2 in a Chinese-name version, not the same capture). Source 2's header line shows a start time of 2017-11-19 09:00, which does not match the contest date in the catalogue (2017-11-26); contest_date left null. The ranks of the board in source 1 are all distinct (1 to 228) while source 2 shares ranks between tied teams.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader took the copy for an empty Vue app shell, but the seed page of our copy is a full ranklist of this contest and 14 other pages are 2017 contest pages; the root-page captures of 2018 to 2024 are domain-parking or empty application shells.
sources.evidence: The seed is a 228-row ranklist of the 2017 Nanning regional and 14 more 2017 pages of the Guangxi University contest site (invitational, online-round account application, registration), not an empty shell.
